risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.summary: The economic health of the United States and consumer confidence directly impact the company's sales and results.
risks.score_rationale: The company is sensitive to general economic conditions, consumer spending levels, and other external factors, which could decline. (Item 1A, p. 7)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: Heightened competition in the retail sector could lead to market share losses and pricing pressures.
risks.score_rationale: The retail sector is highly competitive, and the company faces competition from online retailers, discount stores, wholesale clubs, and others. (Item 1A, p. 5)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.summary: Unpredictable geopolitical events could disrupt supply chains and affect consumer confidence.
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events such as hostilities, pandemics, or public health crises could negatively impact the company's operations. (Item 1A, p. 7)

risks.title: Supply Chain Dependency
risks.summary: The company must manage supplier relationships to ensure operational continuity.
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on suppliers for merchandise, and any issues with these suppliers could negatively impact operations. (Item 1A, p. 5)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.summary: The company must invest in cybersecurity to protect its data and customer information.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, including hacker attacks and data breaches. (Item 1C, p. 17)

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.summary: The company must manage its reputation to maintain consumer and investor trust.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputation risks, such as negative social media or media coverage. (Item 1A, p. 7)
